fields.Name: GetConversationsForMemoryManager
fields.UserQuestion: What conversations have new activity that need to be analyzed for memory extraction?
fields.Description: Returns all conversation data needed for memory extraction in a single query: conversations with new activity, their details with ratings, and linked agent runs for scope inheritance. Optimized to replace 4 separate sequential queries.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Single-query optimization that replaces 4 separate RunView calls in Memory Manager (get conversations, get agent runs, get details, get ratings). Uses SQL Server FOR JSON PATH to aggregate conversation details with ratings as JSON arrays. Returns rating summary flags (HasPositiveRating, HasNegativeRating, IsUnrated) and most recent AgentRunID for scope inheritance. Reduces database round trips from 4 to 1.

fields.Name: agentIds
fields.Description: Required list of values for agent Ids

fields.Name: UserID
fields.Description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the conversation

fields.Name: AgentRunID
fields.Description: Most recent agent run ID for this conversation (for scope inheritance)
fields.ComputationDescription: Scalar subquery selecting TOP 1 agent run ID ordered by StartedAt DESC

fields.Name: MessagesJSON
fields.Description: JSON array containing all conversation details with ratings
fields.ComputationDescription: FOR JSON PATH subquery aggregating conversation details and ratings

fields.Name: HasPositiveRating
fields.Description: Flag indicating if conversation has any rating >= 8
fields.ComputationDescription: CASE expression checking for existence of ratings >= 8

fields.Name: HasNegativeRating
fields.Description: Flag indicating if conversation has any rating <= 3
fields.ComputationDescription: CASE expression checking for existence of ratings <= 3

fields.Name: IsUnrated
fields.Description: Flag indicating if conversation has no ratings
fields.ComputationDescription: CASE expression checking for absence of any ratings
